```artifact
Feature: Admin and Patient Information Management

  As an admin, I want to update doctor, lab, and chemist information in the system
  As a patient, I want to update my personal details and create appointments

Scenario Outline: Updating Information
  Given I am logged in as an admin
  When I update doctor information
  Then the doctor profile should be updated

  Given I am logged in as an admin
  When I update lab information
  Then the lab profile should be updated

  Given I am logged in as an admin
  When I update chemist information
  Then the chemist profile should be updated

Scenario Outline: Creating Appointments
  Given I am a patient
  When I create an appointment
  Then the appointment should be created

  Given I am a patient
  When I view my appointment
  Then the appointment should be visible in my appointment file

Examples:
  | Role   | Information Type | Status |
  | Admin  | Doctor           | Updated |
  | Admin  | Lab             | Updated |
  | Admin  | Chemist         | Updated |
  | Patient | Personal Details | Updated |
  | Patient | Appointment       | Created |

Scenario Outline: Updating Information with Edge Cases
  Given I am logged in as an admin
  When I update doctor information with edge case
  Then the doctor profile should be updated with edge case

  Given I am logged in as an admin
  When I update lab information with edge case
  Then the lab profile should be updated with edge case

  Given I am logged in as an admin
  When I update chemist information with edge case
  Then the chemist profile should be updated with edge case

Examples:
  | Role   | Information Type | Status | Edge Case |
  | Admin  | Doctor           | Updated | Missing ID |
  | Admin  | Lab             | Updated | Invalid Name |
  | Admin  | Chemist         | Updated | Unauthorized Access |
  | Patient | Personal Details | Updated | Invalid Email |
  | Patient | Appointment       | Created | Future Date |

Scenario Outline: Creating Appointments with Edge Cases
  Given I am a patient
  When I create an appointment with edge case
  Then the appointment should be created with edge case

  Given I am a patient
  When I view my appointment with edge case
  Then the appointment should be visible in my appointment file with edge case

Examples:
  | Role   | Information Type | Status | Edge Case |
  | Patient | Appointment       | Created | Non-Existent ID |
  | Patient | Appointment       | Created | Future Date |
  | Patient | Appointment       | Created | Invalid Email |

```
